description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class for testing the Education entity within the OrangeHRM system. It verifies the creation, persistence, and retrieval of Education entities in the database.

classes.name: EducationTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing basic CRUD operations on the Education entity in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating the Education table to ensure a clean state before each test.

methods.name: testEducationEntity
methods.description: Creates a new Education entity, sets its name, persists it, and then verifies that it has been correctly stored and retrieved with the expected values.
